messages:
Emma: Hey team — quick sync on ACME SI's daily usage sampling. Partner reports ~0.8% dropped events on spotty networks. We need a loss heuristic for our marketplace pipeline that avoids over/under billing. Thoughts?
Carlos: Do we have sequence ids in payloads? If yes, we can detect gaps and compute loss rate per device.
Li: yes, devices send seq_id + batch_ts. Drops happen during connectivity blips.
Nora: For billing we can't rely on per-device extrapolation; use aggregate extrapolation with confidence intervals. Propose daily window + 95% CI, flag >0.5% discrepancies.
Carlos: Implement gap detector that emits `missing_range` events to audit log; also include sample checksum to detect reorder vs loss.
Priya: Finance needs a conservative policy: don't bill unconfirmed usage. If we extrapolate, label it as estimated and include customer credit rules.
Emma: Action items: (1) define missing_range schema; (2) add estimated_flag + confidence; (3) partner replay window 48h; (4) dedupe key = partner_id|device_id|seq_id.
Li: 48h replay is ok, but for low-connectivity devices we sometimes see 7-day delays. Can we accept late arrivals as non-billable after 7d?
Priya: We can allow late arrivals up to 7d marked as `late_nonbilled` and offer partner reconciliation statement weekly.
Carlos: Implementation note: add `ack_window` stamp in our ingest. If partner ack not received within ack_window, mark for sampling heuristics (we'll sample 1% of these for manual review).
metering-bot: deploy started to staging: branch=feature/usage-sampling commit=abc1234
Emma: Thanks. Also need test vectors from ACME with synthetic gaps.
Li: I'll drop 3 sample payloads in the S3 path: s3://partner-acme/tests/sampling_vectors.zip — includes seq gaps, reorders, duplicate batches.
Carlos: I'll add unit tests for gap-detection and a small sim script to approximate bias from extrapolation.
Nora: Add a daily monitoring chart for estimated_vs_confirmed ratio; alert at >1%. Also include a slow-growth signal to catch creeping bias.
Priya: Slack note: this affects revenue recognition — we'll loop in accounting to sign off on policy text.
Emma: ok looping @Kevin-bizdev and @Maya-accounting
Kevin-bizdev: acknowledged, will schedule a 30m sync with ACME next Tue.
Maya-accounting: pls cc our revenue accountant on the meeting invite.
Emma: Great. Next steps — Carlos & Li create PRs with schema + test vectors by EOD Fri. Nora creates dashboard mock. Priya and Maya to agree on policy doc. Kevin to set partner sync.
Carlos: sounds good :thumbsup:
Li: on it :white_check_mark:
Emma: thanks all!
